audience_question: Which shuttle option meets the minimum range at the lowest upfront cost?
fit_rationale: All shuttle options share the same criteria, and the matrix aligns range with upfront and annual energy costs so the minimum-range filter and cost comparison are directly readable.
tradeoff: Alder is the least expensive qualifying option upfront, while Birch and Dogwood have lower estimated annual energy costs; Alder is not best on every criterion.
caveats: The 200 km minimum excludes Cedar despite its lower $35k upfront cost.
Annual energy estimates assume 18,000 km of service per vehicle and exclude maintenance and charging-infrastructure costs.
All figures are fictional estimates from the same procurement worksheet; no uncertainty ranges were provided.
